name: core
about: Always loaded: plots with sliders, circuits, runnable JavaScript, replay, animation (anime.js)
api: Pix.plot(el, {fns:["x^2 - 2x + 3", "(f(1+h)-f(1))/h*(x-1)+f(1)"], sliders:{h:[0.01,2,1.5]}, points:[[1,2,"P"]], x:[-1,4], labels:["f(x)","secant"]}) — later formulas can call f(…) and g(…) (the first two); slider variables work in any formula; draws itself in; drag, zoom, hover
Pix.circuit(el, {parts:[{type:"battery"|"resistor"|"led"|"lamp"|"switch"|"capacitor"|"motor", label}], current:true}) — one loop, animated current
Pix.replay(el, stage => {…}) — Replay button that reruns your own animation
anime.animate(targets, {…}) — anime.js v4 for custom animation
el is an element or CSS selector (made if missing); CSS vars: --fg --muted --accent --accent-2 --good --blue --pink --card --line; class pix-box for a card
